routes.name: Exact refutation of a literal manuscript assertion

C9000186.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 186 (Uniform influence and sharp thresholds for graph and hypergraph properties.; papers: A uniform influence bound for hypergraph properties; A Sharp Threshold Bound for Monotone Graph Properties; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/186.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

G_FOURIER.statement: Biased Fourier derivative/Parseval identities and the arbitrary-coordinate low-degree influence estimate (graph fourier.tex).

G_RESTRICTION.statement: Exact averaging of restricted Fourier mass and influences, without imposing an exterior degree cutoff.

G_BLOCK.statement: All block permutations survive exterior conditioning and free-edge orbits have size at least m; averaged graph block estimate.

G_CAPTURE.statement: Graph support degree witness and fixed-size one-vertex capture imply captured Fourier mass up to k^2/2.

G_VARIANCE.statement: For every graph property, n>=2 and 0<p<1, Var_p(f)<=2^17 I_p(f)/(log n)^2, without monotonicity.

G_THRESHOLD.statement: Finite Russo identity and log-odds integration give graph quantile width <=2^19 log(1/(2 epsilon))/(log n)^2.

H_FOURIER.statement: Arbitrary-coordinate biased Fourier identities and low-degree mass estimate, independently of monotonicity.

H_BLOCK.statement: For r+1<=m, all free-edge block orbits have size binomial(m,j)>=m; averaged block mass <=m^(-1/4)(rm/n)I.

H_DEGREE_WITNESS.statement: Derive a support vertex of positive degree at most real k from simplicity, uniformity, incidence counting, and |S|<=(k/r)^(r/(r-1)).

H_UNIFORM_ISOLATION.statement: Uniform m-subset isolation probability >=(m/n)(1-(|V|-1)(m-1)/(n-1)), including m=1.

V_HYPERGRAPH_CAPTURE.statement: Literal hypergraph lem:capture for all n>=r>=3, 1<=m<=n and real k>0, with its original real cutoff and sampling law.

H_CAPTURED_MASS.statement: Averaged block and capture estimates imply mass up to L <=2r m^(-1/4)I; L<1 gives an empty sum.

H_VARIANCE.statement: For each r>=3, all n>=r and 0<p<1, Var_p(f)<=C_r I_p(f)/(log n)^(r/(r-1)); tail cancellation has positive bias exponent.

H_TAIL.statement: For every positive real L, genuine product variance is at most the low-degree Fourier mass plus p(1-p)I/L; also Var<=p(1-p)I. No symmetry or monotonicity is required.

H_UNIFORM_CONSTANTS.statement: For each r>=3, a positive finite constant and a small-n/large-n numerical dichotomy exist uniformly for every 0<sigma<=1/2, with a bias-independent fixed-size block witness and the full capture-plus-tail coefficient bound.

H_THRESHOLD.statement: Finite Russo identity and log-odds integration give hypergraph quantile width <=2C_r log((1-epsilon)/epsilon)/(log n)^(r/(r-1)).
